uncertainties: Worktop footprint is taken from the top view and assumed to cover the full L base runs; the exact extent over the tall column and end unit is not fully verified.
The tall end column B09 has no supplied front IDs; its front type and whether it is a cabinet or fixed panel is unresolved.
Hinged versus lift-up direction for the portrait fronts F04 to F08 is not shown and is assumed.
Continuity of the wing 003 column and the wing 004 tall column with their base runs is assumed from alignment, not explicit construction.

review.front: All three return 17 hinged doors, 5 drawers, 2 lift-up fronts, 0 unresolved. Both wings and drawer banks present, zero legs. Matching counts on these three calls do not prove general reliability.
review.front_known_false_regions: Each retains the lower side candidate as hinged (runs 1/3 F11, run 2 F01) and appliance-opening candidate as hinged (runs 1/3 F08, run 2 F10). Tall end-side treatment varies in exclusions, not totals.
review.format: Front exact enums pass only run 2; runs 1/3 fail snake_case labels. Planner runs 1/2 stop at max_tokens=6000 and are unparseable; no repair or accepted plan. Planner run 3 passes on a failed Front reference. Zero of three complete pairs pass both stage formats.

completed_plan_run_3.worktop: S01 is separately listed on Top view, but its bbox bottom 810 misses the terminal chamfered end of one base wing. Rectangular empty interior of an L-shaped bounding box is expected and is not itself an error. Full footprint coverage not accepted.
completed_plan_run_3.block_boxes: B08 contains F21/F22/F23/F24 in text, but bbox x=595..735 covers the end door, not the drawer fronts at x=446..597. B06 bbox also covers only part of its hanging door pair; B01 excludes its lift-up fronts spatially. Full-carcass localization rule not met.
completed_plan_run_3.physical_scope: B09 treats the tall right end side as a separate cabinet column without front IDs; its own uncertainty admits fixed-panel alternative. Known physical-role issue persists.
completed_plan_run_3.assignment: All supplied IDs assigned exactly once, but syntactic assignment does not establish physical correctness.

review.visual_review: All three Front detail overlays and the sole valid Planner page overlay inspected. Display-only enum aliases for Front 1/3, no aliases for Front 2 or Planner. Truncated planners not rendered.
review.decision: Keep Front V2 / Planner V4 defaults and protected checkpoint. Preserve V3/V7 evidence, no promotion or deployment. Stop after six authorized calls.
review.next_proposed: Separate output-completion/enum reliability from physical recognition. Before another recognition prompt change, address Planner completion as a bounded output-contract experiment; no budget increase or schema change is pre-authorized.
